prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Begin Your Companion Journey", "body": "Scroll through the origin story to choose how your new desktop pet will join your workspace."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in automatically backs up and syncs all your pets and custom items securely.", "show_step_counter": true}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Split Screen Pet Adoption & Certificate Hub: Redesign the adoption pick_friend screen using a split layout to highlight pet personality alongside certificate creation.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Adopt Your Unique Companion", "body": "Select a friend to see their dynamic adoption certificate side by side."}}
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Setup Checklist on Waiting Screen: Add an explicit interactive display setup checklist to the waiting screen to guide desktop rendering setup.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Preparing Desktop Companion", "show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "1. Verify screen overlay permissions\n2. Keep app running in system tray\n3. Select primary display monitor", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Pet Control Basics Screen: Introduce a new screen before home_intro that teaches core desktop pet interaction shortcuts like hiding, dragging, and talking.
   config: {"new_pet_controls": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Mastering Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Drag to move your pet, right-click to hide to tray, or click to chat anytime.", "button_label": "Got It!"}, "home_intro": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_controls", "home_intro"]}}
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Photo Requirements Guide: Add clear image quality guidelines and hints on the photo upload screen to ensure high-fidelity pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use well-lit, clear photos focused on a single subject for best rendering results.", "show_time_estimate": true}}
6: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight View for Story Screen: Change the story screen layout to a spotlight format to emphasize core pet narrative before path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Sanctuary"}}
7: [sign_in, incentive] Exclusive Pet Item Sign-In Bonus Callout: Display a visual sign-in bonus badge offering an exclusive starter item upon creating or linking an account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Unlock Golden Collar Bonus", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [home, new_flow] Desktop Rendering Verification Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring live visual status updates of the companion build process.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Assembling Your Desktop Friend", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
9: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Quick-Access Notification: Add system tray quick-access instructions and notification toggle on the final home_intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Your pet is active! Access settings anytime via the desktop system tray icon."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while preserving onboarding steps and core narrative job is allowed.
Adding reassurance copy regarding account backup on sign-in screen complies with all base rules.
Redesigning pick_friend with a split view previewing the certificate does not remove required steps or core functionality.
Adding a display setup checklist to the waiting screen maintains the core job of showing the pet is being prepared.
Adding a new pet controls tutorial screen within onboarding before home_intro while keeping all mandatory steps passes all rules.
Adding image quality guidance to the photo upload screen is valid inside onboarding.
Changing the story screen layout to a spotlight view preserves the pet story introduction job.
Promoting an exclusive bonus item ('Unlock Golden Collar Bonus') violates Rule 3, which prohibits mentioning gifts, bonuses, or free extras in onboarding copy.
Updating waiting screen visual layout to show live assembly progress complies with waiting screen requirements.
Adding system tray instructions and notification options to home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
